findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: browse-schools · Private data: get-schools, browse-schools, find-school, find-places, explain-admissions-method, get-admissions-demand · Public sink: rank-neighborhoods, explain-score.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: browse-schools · Private data: get-schools, browse-schools, find-school, find-places, explain-admissions-method, get-admissions-demand · Public sink: rank-neighborhoods, explain-score

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
